english translation text: TAKE THE FLAG AND COME O’ FLAG BEARER

arabic text: LEKE ALAM TUM AAWO ALAMDAAR\nMASHK BHAR KE TUM LAAWO ALAMDAAR
english translation text: TAKE THE FLAG AND COME O’ FLAG BEARER,\nFILL THE MASHK AND BRING IT O’ FLAG BEARER

arabic text:
EK TARAF HAA-E KHAIMEN HAI JALTE
NANHE BACHCHE HAI PAANI KO TARASTE
AA KE INHE TUM PAANI PILAAWO
MASHK BHAR KE TUM LAAWO ALAMDAAR
english translation text:
ON ONE SIDE THE TENTS ARE BURNING,
THE YOUNG CHILDREN ARE THIRSTING FOR WATER,
COME AND GIVE THEM WATER
FILL THE MASHK AND BRING IT O’ FLAG BEARER

arabic text:
BHAAI ZARAA TUM KHAIMEN ME AAWO
ROT-E HAI BACHCHE AA KE MANAWO
CHHOTI SAKINAA KO MUNH TO DIKHAA-O
MASHK BHAR KE TUM LAAWO ALAMDAAR
english translation text:
O BROTHER ABBAS (A.S.) COME TO THE TENTS,
THE CHILDREN ARE CRYING, COME COMFORT THEM,
AT LEAST SHOW YOUR FACE TO YOUNG SAKINA,
FILL THE MASHK AND COME O’ FLAG BEARER

arabic text:
PYAARI SAKINAA DHUNDH RAHI HAI
HAA-E MACHAL KE KEH RAHI HAI
MUJH KO MILAA DO APNE CHACHAA SE
MASHK BHAR KE TUM LAAWO ALAMDAAR
english translation text:
BELOVED SAKINA IS LOOKING FOR YOU,
SHE IS IN PAIN AND CALLING OUT,
FILL THE MASHK AND COME O’ FLAG BEARER
‘BRING MY UNCLE TO ME’,

arabic text:
AB TO YAQIN HAI CHAADAR CHHINEN GI
BALWE MEN KHUL-E SAR HAA-E PHIREN GI
KHULD MEN BAA BAA HAMKO BULAA LO
MASHK BHAR KE TUM LAAWO ALAMDAAR
english translation text:
NOW WE ARE SURE OUR VEIL WILL BE STOLEN,
IN THIS DESERT WE WILL BE FORCED TO MOVE WITHOUT OUR HEADS COVERED,
CALL US TOWARDS YOU O’ FATHER,
FILL THE MASHK AND COME O’ FLAG BEARER

arabic text:
ROT-E HAI BHAAI NEHR PE BAITHE
LAASH-E KE QARIB PUSHT KO PAKD-E
SAMJAA KE UNKO KHIMEN ME LAA-O
MASHK BHAR KE TUM LAAWO ALAMDAAR
english translation text:
OUR BROTHER IS CRYING NEAR THE RIVER,
HE IS NEAR YOUR BODY HOLDING HIS BACK,
COMFORT HIM AND BRING HIM TO THE TENTS,
FILL THE MASHK AND COME O’ FLAG BEARER

arabic text:
AB NA RAHAA HAI KOI MADAD GAAR
TUM BHI CHAL BAS-E HAA-E ALAMDAAR
NAJAF SE TUM BAA BAA KO BULAA LO
MASHK BHAR KE TUM LAAWO ALAMDAAR
english translation text:
NOW THERE IS NO ONE LEFT TO HELP US,
YOU ALSO LEFT US O’ FLAG BEARER,
CALL OUR FATHER FROM NAJAF,
FILL THE MASHK AND COME O’ FLAG BEARER
